job.title: Security Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Engineer to join a large-scale cyber transformation program focused on strengthening and modernising enterprise security capabilities.

About the Role
As a Cyber Security Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering security engineering initiatives across enterprise and cloud environments. You will be responsible for implementing and optimising security technologies, enhancing monitoring capabilities, and supporting the ongoing uplift of cyber security practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer, configure, and maintain security technologies across enterprise and cloud environments.
  • Enhance SIEM, EDR, and security monitoring platforms to improve threat detection and response capabilities.
  • Develop detection rules, dashboards, and automated response mechanisms to operationalise threat intelligence.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments, analyse findings, and work with technology teams to drive remediation activities.
  • Implement and maintain secure cloud configurations across Azure and AWS environments.
  • Support security architecture, monitoring, access controls, and data protection initiatives.
  • Contribute to incident response activities, investigations, and security hardening programs.
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to improve overall cyber security maturity.

About You:

  • Experience in Cyber Security Engineering, Security Operations, or a related cyber security discipline.
  • Strong understanding of networking, operating systems, and core cyber security principles.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • SIEM platforms
  • Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) solutions
  • Firewalls
  • Vulnerability Management tools
  • Cloud-native security technologies
  • Knowledge of cloud security practices across Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Experience supporting cyber security incident investigation, response, and remediation.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across both technical and non-technical teams.

Highly Regarded Experience working with or knowledge of:

  • ISO 27001
  • NIST Cyber Security Framework (NIST CSF)
  • ASD Essential Eight
  • Security monitoring and threat detection engineering
  • Vulnerability management and remediation programs
  • Security automation and orchestration
  • Critical infrastructure, enterprise, or highly regulated environments

What's on Offer?

  • Permanent opportunity within a growing cyber security function.
  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.
  • Exposure to enterprise-scale cyber security transformation initiatives.
  • Opportunity to work across modern cloud and infrastructure environments.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact in strengthening organisational cyber resilience.

job.title: Data Analyst
job.description:
We are seeking a commercially minded Data Analyst to join a growing Data & Insights team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a data-driven organisation where you will play a key role in transforming information into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making, operational performance, and customer outcomes.
As a Data Analyst, you will work closely with stakeholders across the business to develop reporting solutions, analyse trends, and provide recommendations that drive business improvement.

About the Organisation

Our client is a well-established organisation that plays an important role in supporting individuals, businesses, and communities across Australia. With a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and customer outcomes, the organisation leverages data and insights to inform strategic decision-making and enhance service delivery.

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative environment where data is highly valued and analytics plays a key role in shaping business outcomes.
About the Role Reporting into the Data & Analytics function, you will:

  • Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Write and optimise SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyse data from multiple sources.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and deliver actionable insights.
  • Support data quality initiatives and contribute to data governance practices.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis to support operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Assist in the development and enhancement of KPI reporting frameworks.
  • Work with cloud-based data platforms including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Contribute to data modelling and reporting solutions that improve business visibility and performance.

About You:

  • Previous experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or similar analytics-focused position.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
  • Strong experience developing reports and dashboards in Power BI.
  • Experience using Python or other programming languages for analytics and automation.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, or other cloud data platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience translating business requirements into meaningful reporting and insights.
  • Understanding of data modelling principles and reporting best practices.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with data warehousing, ETL processes, and modern analytics platforms.
  • Knowledge of DAX, Power Query, and advanced Power BI development.
  • Exposure to customer, operational, education, workforce, or service-based datasets.
  • Understanding of data governance and data quality frameworks.

What's on Offer?

  • 12-month fixed-term contract.
  • South-east suburb location with flexible hybrid working arrangements.
  • Opportunity to work with modern cloud and analytics technologies, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Collaborative team environment with strong stakeholder engagement.
  • The chance to influence business decisions through data-driven insights.
  • Exposure to key business stakeholders and strategic projects.
  • A supportive, collaborative culture focused on innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Opportunities to further develop your technical and analytical capabilities.


If you are passionate about transforming data into meaningful business outcomes and enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Support Officer
job.description:
We're seeking a proactive and customer-focused IT Support Officer to become the on-site face of IT for a growing national business.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys a mix of end-user support, device provisioning, asset management, and hands-on technical troubleshooting. You'll work closely with a remote technology team while taking ownership of local IT operations and ensuring employees have the tools and support they need to remain productive.

About the Role As the first point of contact for IT support, you'll provide hands-on assistance across a broad range of technologies, resolving day-to-day technical issues while supporting device deployment, onboarding activities, and technology asset management. You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and will play a key role in maintaining a seamless IT experience for end users.
Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 1 IT support across hardware, software, Microsoft 365, printing, mobility, and connectivity issues.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests through an ITSM platform.
  • Support meeting room technology, printers, mobile devices, and end-user computing environments.
  • Build, configure, deploy, and maintain laptops and other end-user devices.
  • Facilitate employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including device allocation, user access, and equipment recovery.
  • Manage technology assets, maintain accurate asset registers, and monitor stock levels of IT equipment and accessories.
  • Coordinate hardware repairs, warranties, returns, and logistics activities.

About You To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • At least 2 years' experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or Helpdesk position.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows environments and Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience supporting:
  • Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)
  • Windows desktops and laptops
  • Printers and peripherals
  • Mobile devices
  • Basic networking environments
  • Experience working with ITSM/ticketing platforms.
  • Device deployment and provisioning experience, ideally using Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot.
  • Strong organisational skills with exposure to asset and inventory management.

Desirable Skills

  • Exposure to Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) administration.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Microsoft certifications such as MS-900 or MD-102.

What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is:

  • Self-motivated and able to work autonomously.
  • Customer-focused with a strong service mentality.
  • Organised, reliable, and accountable.
  • A strong problem solver with excellent attention to detail.
  • Passionate about continuous improvement and delivering a great user experience.

If you're looking for an opportunity where you can take ownership of local IT support while broadening your technical skills and exposure, we'd love to hear from you.
